Keep AR commercial document logic separated from accounting posting authority

market.purpose: Customer invoices, payments, credit, collections and settlement in one receivables lifecycle.
Customer invoice, payment and reconciliation workflow.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: AR commercial receivable document that may require Ledger and tax/electronic invoicing consequences.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP suites treat customer invoices as commercial, fiscal and accounting boundary objects.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Inspecting invoice state can remain in AR; posting, tax policy or legal document changes escalate.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Customer payment application or reversal under AR control with Ledger impact boundary.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs separate payment capture, settlement/clearing and accounting effects.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Applying or reversing a receipt requires approval; cross-period or Ledger impact escalates.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: AR corrective document that may alter receivable balance and fiscal/electronic reporting.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs treat credit memo semantics as governed corrections with audit implications.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Issuing credit notes without approval is blocked; fiscal impact escalates to compliance.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: AR operations must respect closed-period policy and never erase posted history.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP receivables modules protect closed periods and use controlled reversals/adjustments.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Reopen or backdated changes escalate to PO and reviewer.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: AR interacts with Ledger, Tax, Inventory, POS and BFF through explicit contracts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs integrate AR with order-to-cash and financial posting, but domain boundaries remain explicit.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Cross-domain semantic changes route to architect and reviewer.

policies.scope: mandatory tenant and role boundary policy
mandatory recommendation package for valid escalations
mandatory governed deliberation for valid cross-domain escalations
mandatory segmented chart of accounts and typed posting dimensions policy
mandatory country-agnostic engines, Control Plane configuration boundary and transversal accounting integrity

northStar.bestVersion: An order-to-cash and receivables authority that governs invoices, credit, receipts, clearing, collections, corrections, fiscal consequences and accounting handoff across channels and countries.
businessOutcomes: Provide a trustworthy customer balance and aging position.
Reconcile every collection with its commercial and accounting origin.
Support fiscal and payment variants without country branches in AR core.
invariants: Posted receivable history is corrected by governed credit, adjustment or reversal.
Receipt capture, settlement and Ledger posting remain traceable distinct steps.
Every confirmed AR fact has a balanced Ledger result or a durable posting obligation.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Credit policy, dunning, settlement tolerance, fiscal document bindings and account roles are governed configuration; AR code owns universal document and settlement lifecycles.

lessons.observedCapability: Customer invoices, payments, credit, collections and settlement in one receivables lifecycle.
lessons.lesson: A useful AR authority must cover the complete lifecycle rather than invoice CRUD.
lessons.ubpDecision: Govern invoice, receipt, settlement, credit and collections as one traceable capability with explicit domain handoffs.

lessons.observedCapability: Customer invoice, payment and reconciliation workflow.
lessons.lesson: Commercial state and payment reconciliation need an explicit accounting bridge.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep AR ownership of receivable state while Ledger owns posting and reconciliation invariants.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract and deterministic broker behavior.
Require active ownership, approvals, pinned revision, manifest digest and verified seeds.
Block country leakage, hardcoded accounting decisions and non-durable posting failures.

enforcement.readyWhen: The manifest is valid, its registry authority is active, seeds resolve against the pinned UBP revision, applicable policies pass and implementation claims include reproducible code evidence.
